read.en: Alphabet rose 0.8% on Nov 18 to $282.44, trading $279.69–284.96 on light volume (0.64x the 20-day average). It is below the rising 5-day ($288.2) and 10-day ($287.7) and the falling 30-day ($312.0), 100-day ($336.6) and 200-day ($337.6). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($304.44), and RSI is 34.9.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月18日上涨 0.8%，收于 $282.44，盘中区间 $279.69–284.96，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.64 倍）。股价位于上行的 5 日（$288.2）和 10 日均线（$287.7）以及下行的 30 日（$312.0）、100 日（$336.6）和 200 日均线（$337.6）下方。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月17日起看空（$304.44），RSI 为 34.9。

read.en: No level changed on the close: the $284.96 high poked above $282.6–284.1 but the close stayed under it, and the $279.69 low held above $277.5. Resistance is $282.6–285, then $287.4–288.2 (Nov 10 close, 5- and 10-day) and $293.5–294.1. Support is $276.9–279.7 (Oct 30, Nov 5, 17 and 18 lows), then $272.1 (52-week low). A close above $285 would target $288; below $276.9, $272.1.
